QUOTE: "With a callback registered, the only way a call is refused is the deny list." (also: "`check_approval` sets `approved = true` after calling it")
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the host callback cannot deny, so an unmatched tool is approved and runs and only the deny list refuses. That is default-allow at the gate, though the answer qualifies it with a no-callback denial.
